development_budget.selection_rule: The original retention rule applies to the primary output: no reduction in fault localization, no increase in clean false attribution, and fewer wrong fault attributions or a declared engineering defect fixed. Raw and alternative-validator results are secondary audits, not post hoc selection targets. On conflicting results retain prioritized selection and label the candidate inconclusive. A demonstrated modality-starvation fix may be retained when both methods meet the no-regression gates; this need not be an accuracy gain.
